title: GoodRx Savings vs Copay Paid
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=goodrx:price drug_name=* lowest_price_usd=*
| join type=inner drug_name [search index=personal sourcetype=cvs:refill | stats latest(copay_usd) as copay by drug_name]
| eval savings_usd=round(copay-lowest_price_usd,2)
| where savings_usd>5
| sort - savings_usd
| table drug_name copay lowest_price_usd savings_usd
description: Compares CVS copays against GoodRx lowest prices for the same drug names.
value: Copay-versus-coupon gaps show where cash price beats insurance and saves real money monthly.
implementation: Match `drug_name` across GoodRx lookups and CVS refill receipts, then review positive savings monthly.
visualization: Table of drugs with potential savings in dollars.
grandmaExplanation: It counts prescriptions where GoodRx could have been cheaper than your copay.
